title: When Does Closed-Loop Curriculum Adaptation Help GRPO? An Analysis on Countdown
abstract: arXiv:2610.39056v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement fine-tuning has become an effective post-training paradigm for improving the reasoning ability of large language models, but it remains sample-inefficient when the training distribution is mismatched to the model's current capability. In group-relative objectives such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), problems that are too hard often produce uniformly failed rollouts, while problems that are too easy provide little useful advantage signal. In this work, we introduce CLOSEDLOOPGAUSSIAN, a lightweight adaptive curriculum method for efficient reinforcement fine-tuning on ordered reasoning tasks. Instead of following a fixed easy-to-hard schedule, CLOSEDLOOPGAUSSIAN preserves the structure of an Easy-to-Hard Gaussian sampler while dynamically adjusting its pace and spread using periodic probe estimates of per-difficulty accuracy. The controller accelerates training when the model is ahead of a reference curriculum

translated_title: 闭环课程自适应何时有助于GRPO？基于Countdown任务的分析
translated_abstract: 强化微调已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的有效后训练范式，但当训练分布与模型当前能力不匹配时，其样本效率仍然低下。在组相对策略优化（GRPO）等组相对目标中，过难的问题往往产生全部失败的采样结果，而过易的问题则几乎无法提供有用的优势信号。在本工作中，我们提出了CLOSEDLOOPGAUSSIAN，一种面向有序推理任务高效强化微调的轻量级自适应课程方法。该方法不遵循固定的由易到难调度，而是在保留由易到难高斯采样器结构的同时，利用对各难度等级准确率的周期性探测估计，动态调整其推进节奏与分布范围。当模型进度领先于参考课程时，控制器会加速训练
tldr: 提出CLOSEDLOOPGAUSSIAN，一种轻量级闭环自适应课程方法，通过周期性探测各难度准确率来动态调整由易到难高斯采样的节奏与分布范围，从而提升GRPO在Countdown等有序推理任务上强化微调的样本效率。
en_tdlr: CLOSEDLOOPGAUSSIAN is a lightweight closed-loop adaptive curriculum method that dynamically adjusts the pace and spread of an easy-to-hard Gaussian sampler using periodic probe estimates of per-difficulty accuracy, making GRPO-based reinforcement fine-tuning more sample-efficient on ordered reasoning tasks such as Countdown.
